segments.speaker: 旁白
segments.text:
门上贴着一张纸，写着“今日盘点，暂停营业”。
林小雪把伞收起来，抖了抖水。她抬头看了看招牌，又低头核对手机上的地址。

segments.speaker: 旁白
segments.text:
那姑娘没理他，绕到侧门去敲了三下。
里面传来拖沓的脚步声。门开了一条缝，露出半张脸。

segments.speaker: 旁白
segments.text:
周远刚要开口，被她拦住了。
他想，这人怕是记错了日子。

segments.speaker: 旁白
segments.text: 门后的人沉默了几秒，把门推开了。

segments.speaker: 旁白
segments.text: 店里堆着半人高的纸箱。一个中年男人从柜台后面站起来，手里还捏着计算器。

segments.speaker: 张师傅
segments.text: “你们是来取那台 CD 机的？”

segments.speaker: 张师傅
segments.text: “押金三百二，机器一千零八十。”

segments.speaker: 旁白
segments.text:
周远点点头。
林小雪凑过去看那本子。上面一行字被水洇开了，只剩下半个“雪”字。

segments.speaker: 旁白
segments.text: 张师傅说完又补了一句，

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune must be in want of a wife.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: However little known the feelings or views of such a man may be on his first entering a neighbourhood, this truth is so well fixed in the minds of the surrounding families,

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: that he is considered as the rightful property of some one or other of their daughters.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: said his lady to him one day,

segments.speaker: Mrs. Bennet
segments.text: “have you heard that Netherfield Park is let at last?”

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Mr. Bennet replied that he had not.

segments.speaker: Mrs. Bennet
segments.text: “for Mrs. Long has just been here, and she told me all about it.”

segments.speaker: Mrs. Bennet
segments.text: “Do not you want to know who has taken it?”

segments.speaker: Mr. Bennet
segments.text: “You want to tell me, and I have no objection to hearing it.”

segments.speaker: Mrs. Bennet
segments.text: “Why, my dear, you must know, Mrs. Long says that Netherfield is taken by a young man of large fortune from the north of England;

segments.speaker: Mrs. Bennet
segments.text: that he came down on Monday in a chaise and four to see the place, and was so much delighted with it that he agreed with Mr. Morris immediately;

segments.speaker: Mrs. Bennet
segments.text: that he is to take possession before Michaelmas, and some of his servants are to be in the house by the end of next week.”

segments.speaker: Mrs. Bennet
segments.text: “Oh, single, my dear, to be sure! A single man of large fortune; four or five thousand a year. What a fine thing for our girls!”

segments.speaker: Mr. Bennet
segments.text: “How so? how can it affect them?”

segments.speaker: Mrs. Bennet
segments.text: “how can you be so tiresome? You must know that I am thinking of his marrying one of them.”

segments.speaker: Mr. Bennet
segments.text: “Is that his design in settling here?”

segments.speaker: Mrs. Bennet
segments.text: “Design? Nonsense, how can you talk so! But it is very likely that he may fall in love with one of them, and therefore you must visit him as soon as he comes.”
